## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private URLs or personal data.
- [ ] User-facing instructions and known limitations match the behavior.
- [ ] I have distinguished completed validation from untested cases.

Report vulnerabilities through the private channel in SECURITY.md rather than a public PR.
